rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for restricting or slowing progress, development, or ideas.

example.english: The company's layers of approval stultify our efforts to launch the new project.
example.traditional: 公司層層審批，阻礙咗我哋推行新計劃。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 cang4 cang4 sam2 pai1 zo2 ngoi6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 teoi1 hang4 san1 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when restrictive rules or routines suppress an idea, opportunity, or creativity altogether.

example.english: These rigid rules completely stultify everyone's creativity.
example.traditional: 呢啲死規矩直情扼殺咗大家嘅創意。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 sei2 kwai1 geoi2 zik6 cing4 aak1 saat3 zo2 daai6 gaa1 ge3 cong3 ji3

rows.jyutping: ling6 A bin3 dak1 fat6 mei6
rows.note: Use this specifically when the emphasis is on making an activity, experience, or subject dull and uninteresting.

example.english: Using rigid rules all the time can stultify the classroom experience.
example.traditional: 成日用死板嘅規矩限制學生，會令課堂變得乏味。
example.jyutping: seng4 jat6 jung6 sei2 baan2 ge3 kwai1 geoi2 haan6 zai3 hok6 saang1 wui5 ling6 fo3 tong4 bin3 dak1 fat6 mei6
